title: Build Lamport/Vector Clocks and a Leader-Election Simulator
summary:
Build the theory behind distributed systems as running code. **Lamport clocks** and **vector clocks** (compare: before / after / concurrent; merge), a **Dynamo-style versioned store** that keeps concurrent writes as siblings, and a **deterministic discrete-event simulation of Raft leader election**: terms, RequestVote and the election restriction, randomized timeouts from a seeded RNG, heartbeats, crashes and network partitions.

The judge checks the properties interviewers care about: **at most one leader per term**, even across 25 seeds of random crashes and partitions; re-election after the leader dies; no leader without a majority; a deposed leader in a minority partition; and why randomized timeouts and Pre-Vote exist.

milestones.name: M1: Lamport clocks
milestones.description: tick / send / receive = max + 1; timestamps respect happens-before along a message chain.

milestones.name: M2: Vector clocks
milestones.description: `vcCompare` (before / after / equal / concurrent), `vcMerge`, `vcIncrement`, and a `VectorClock` that detects concurrency Lamport clocks cannot.

milestones.name: M3: Conflict detection with siblings
milestones.description: A `VersionedStore` where writes carry a context; dominated versions are replaced, concurrent ones are kept as siblings until a reconciling write.

milestones.name: M4: Raft RPC rules
milestones.description: Seeded `mulberry32`; `handleRequestVote` (one vote per term, stale terms, step-down, election restriction) and `handleAppendEntries`.

milestones.name: M5: Election simulation
milestones.description: A discrete-event `RaftCluster` with a priority queue, election timers and heartbeats. It elects one leader, is deterministic per seed, stays stable while healthy, and shows that fixed timeouts livelock.

milestones.name: M6: Crashes
milestones.description: Re-election after a leader crash in a higher term, no leader without a majority, and `votedFor` / `currentTerm` that survive restart.

milestones.name: M7: Partitions and safety
milestones.description: Minority leaders keep a stale term until heal; term inflation from an isolated node (the Pre-Vote motivation); and at most one leader per term under seeded chaos.
